record.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the dynamic relationship between Fundamental Rights
    (FRs) and Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSPs) and select the correct answers:
      1. In the Champakam Dorairajan case (1951), the Supreme Court ruled that DPSPs are
         subordinate to FRs and cannot override them.
      2. The 25th Constitutional Amendment Act (1971) introduced Article 31C to give primacy to
         Articles 39(b) and 39(c) over Articles 14, 19, and 31.
      3. In the Minerva Mills case (1980), the Supreme Court declared that the Indian Constitution is
         founded on the bedrock of the balance between Part III and Part IV.
